انتصبوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَصَبُوا (intaṣabū) /in.ta.sˤa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# اُنْتُصِبُوا (untuṣibū) /un.tu.sˤi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# اِنْتَصِبُوا (intaṣibū) /in.ta.sˤi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
